headline: Resolution to end a 2006 national emergency on the Democratic Republic of Congo conflict was voted down in the House.
what_it_does: This resolution would have ended a national emergency that President George W. Bush declared on October 27, 2006. That emergency lets the U.S. government block the property of certain people who contribute to the conflict in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Ending the emergency would have removed the legal basis for those property blocks. The House voted it down on July 18, 2023.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups targeted for contributing to the conflict in the Democratic Republic of Congo
who_it_affects.how: The U.S. block on their property under this emergency would have ended.
They would no longer have been required to freeze property tied to people named under this emergency.
